method: One complete French P0+P1 language batch: manually read every full English/French pair, its complete placeholder signature/alias, and current source consumers. Existing receipt hashes were reconciled after fresh reading. Prior receipts are evidence to reassess, not automatic acceptance. Automated checks validate structure and format only.
hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon; Android escapes retained. Pair hashes use [English,French].

Two prior exact-pair receipts are contested by a concrete composition defect; do not count them as accepted until correction and review.
No changes were made to held PR #56, its tracking branch, public issues or remote application branches.
